# Code of conduct

Storylight welcomes technical discussion, careful criticism, and contributions
from people with different backgrounds and levels of experience.

Be respectful and specific. Discuss the work rather than the person, assume
good faith while evidence is incomplete, and make room for others to
participate. Harassment, threats, discriminatory conduct, sexualized attention,
and publication of another person's private information are unacceptable.

Project maintainers may edit or remove contributions that violate these
expectations and may temporarily or permanently restrict participation.

Report conduct concerns privately through the repository's Security tab. Do
not open a public issue containing sensitive details. Reports will be reviewed
as promptly and impartially as possible, with information shared only when
needed to investigate and respond.
